# Skills.biz.id — Full LLM Knowledge Bundle
> Comprehensive agent-readable dataset of AI agent skills, 139 MCP servers, and top 100 developer repositories.

## Platform Metadata
- Domain: https://skills.biz.id
- Protocol: Anthropic Model Context Protocol (MCP) 1.0
- Supported Clients: Claude Desktop, Cursor AI, OpenAI Codex, Aider, OpenCode
- Machine-Readable Pricing: https://skills.biz.id/pricing.md
- License: Open Source (MIT / Apache 2.0)

## Model Context Protocol (MCP) Catalog (139 Servers across 11 Categories)

### Category: Agent Frameworks & Orchestrators (frameworks)

- License: Open Source
- Self-Hostable: Yes
